physical_justification: QRS is the ventricular depolarisation event — a single Z₂ rupture (depolarised / repolarised) riding on the cardiac SO(2) limit cycle. Predicted as Z₂ sub-rupture jitter, not as full-cycle SO(2).
class_justification: Healthy autonomous His-Purkinje conduction; Class A.
reference: Macfarlane & Lawrie 1989 Comprehensive Electrocardiology; Rautaharju 2009 J Electrocardiol 42:444
notes: Pre-registered direction: MATCH. Predicted CV ≈ 0.159 (Z₂ sub-rupture). Compare to full RR CV ≈ 0.080 (paper row 1, SO(2)).

physical_justification: ST segment spans ventricular plateau — a Z₂ sub-event (depolarised phase ends / starts repolarising) on the cardiac SO(2) cycle.
reference: Surawicz 2009 Chou's Electrocardiography in Clinical Practice §3
notes: Pre-registered direction: MATCH. Predicted CV ≈ 0.159 (Z₂ sub-rupture).

system: PP interval CV (healthy adult, atrial-rate variability)
physical_justification: PP interval measures atrial-to-atrial period — the SA-node continuous limit cycle observed directly without ventricular projection.
class_justification: Autonomous SA-node oscillator under intrinsic vagal/sympathetic noise; Class A.
reference: Anumonwo & Jalife 1995 Cardiac Electrophysiology: From Cell to Bedside
notes: Pre-registered direction: MATCH. Predicted CV = 1/(4π) ≈ 0.0796. Should match supine RR (paper row 1) closely.

system: DDD-paced heart rhythm RR interval CV
physical_justification: Pacemaker forces the cardiac SO(2) cycle to its programmed rate; underlying physiology is bypassed by the device timer.
class_justification: Engineered precision (oscillator-grade timing); Class B SUPPRESSED.
reference: Glikson 2002 Eur Heart J 23:1510; ISHNE pacemaker-rhythm meta-data
notes: Pre-registered direction: SUPPRESSED. Predicted SUPPRESSED well below 0.0796; pacemaker accuracy is sub-millisecond → CV typically < 0.001.

system: Elite endurance athlete resting RR CV (supine)
physical_justification: Same SA-node SO(2) substrate as untrained adults but with elevated trained vagal tone reducing inter-beat fluctuation amplitude.
class_justification: Trained vagal regulation actively narrows Ω; Class B SUPPRESSED. (Note: in some reports this manifests as elevated SDNN despite a lower CV — the prediction is on CV specifically.)
reference: Carter 2003 Med Sci Sports Exerc 35:1333; Aubert 2003 Sports Med 33:889
notes: Pre-registered direction: SUPPRESSED. Predicted SUPPRESSED below 0.0796. Honest open: endurance training is sometimes reported to elevate CV via vagal noise — directional reversal would be informative.

system: Long QT syndrome (LQT1/LQT2) QT interval CV
physical_justification: QT interval still tracks the cardiac SO(2) limit cycle but ion-channel mutation introduces beat-to-beat repolarisation lability.
class_justification: Channelopathy-driven repolarisation noise; Class C ELEVATED.
notes: Pre-registered direction: ELEVATED. Predicted ELEVATED above 0.0796. Compare to paper row 118 healthy QT CV ≈ 0.05.

physical_justification: Same SO(2) cycle but pharmacological IKr blockade destabilises repolarisation.
class_justification: Drug-induced repolarisation noise; Class C ELEVATED.
reference: Hinterseer 2010 Eur Heart J 31:1844; Belardinelli 2003 Trends Pharmacol Sci 24:619
notes: Pre-registered direction: ELEVATED. Predicted ELEVATED. Beat-to-beat QT variability is a torsade biomarker.

physical_justification: PVC vs sinus beat is a binary event (Z₂); coupling-interval distribution rides on the SA-node cycle (the SO(2) regulator).
class_justification: Stochastic ectopic-focus discharge; Class C ELEVATED.
reference: Bogun 2007 Heart Rhythm 4:863; Latchamsetty 2015 J Am Coll Cardiol
notes: Pre-registered direction: ELEVATED. Predicted ELEVATED above 0.159. Some PVC types show fixed coupling (suppressed).

system: Atrial fibrillation RR interval CV (untreated AF)
physical_justification: In AF the atrial activity is disorganised (no coherent SO(2) substrate); AV nodal conduction filters the chaotic atrial input into a near-Poisson ventricular response. Approaches the memoryless limit.
class_justification: No SO(2) regulator on the AV-node-output Z₂ event; Class C, Z₂_only candidate.
reference: Tateno 2001 Med Biol Eng Comput 39:664; Hayano 1997 Am J Cardiol 80:E1
notes: Pre-registered direction: MATCH. Predicted CV ≈ 1 if fully memoryless; literature reports CV ≈ 0.4–0.7 — an intermediate case where some residual SO(2) (rate-control medication, AV-node refractory period) prevents full memoryless limit.

physical_justification: VF wavefronts are spatiotemporally chaotic with no closed SO(2) cycle; local activation Z₂ events are decoupled from any global rotation.
class_justification: No SO(2) regulator anywhere; Class C, Z₂_only candidate.
notes: Pre-registered direction: MATCH. Predicted CV → 1 in the limit. Spatial fibrillation cycle-length data from sock-electrode mapping is the cleanest test.
